# Lionheart Fixt 0.50.0 - the book nobody could find

There are twelve books in this game — proper ones, with titles and descriptions, that sit in your
inventory and can be sold to a collector.

Eleven of them you can get hold of. The twelfth you cannot, anywhere, by any means.

> *"This well written manuscript details the life and trials of a Feralkin at the hands of the
> Inquisition."*

## This one wasn't unfinished

That's the opposite of last release. The two wands in 0.49.0 were names and descriptions sitting on
top of nothing. **This book is complete.** It has its own sound for being picked up and another for
being put down, an icon, a weight, a price, and that description above.

It just isn't for sale, isn't in any chest, isn't in anybody's pocket, and isn't mentioned by anyone.
It exists and cannot be reached.

My own notes had said it "needs a reader more than a quest" — looking for the wrong missing piece.
None of the other eleven books have a reader either. What they have is **a shop**.

## Where it is now

**Weng Choi** in the Gate District deals in rare books. Ten of the twelve come from him, one at a
time: every time you qualify as a valued customer he hands over a different one, cycling through his
stock. The Journal is now the **eleventh** book in that rotation.

He'll also **buy** it from you, with the same "what have you sold me, a rare book?" reaction he gives
for the other ten.

## And someone notices you carrying it

It's an account of the Inquisition torturing a feralkin. Carrying it openly, in front of an
inquisitor, now gets you an answer:

> *"Then you carry a lie, child, and you carry it badly — openly. ⟨He puts out his hand for it, and
> waits.⟩ Whatever that wretch set down, he set it down afterward, which means he set it down alive.
> We are not the thing that manuscript describes. Give it here, and we need not discuss how it came
> to you."*

**He doesn't actually take it.** He puts out his hand, and that's where it ends — you keep the book.
Having an NPC confiscate something you'd hunted down would be a worse scene than his refusal to be
accused already is.

## One small thing fixed on the way past

Its name in the inventory was **"Feralkin Journal."** — with a full stop on the end. It was the only
one of the twelve books like that. The others are *History of the Crusades*, *Tome of Geomancy*, *Art
of Barter*.

## Installing

Unzip and double-click **`Mod Manager.bat`**, then click the button that names the mod.

Works on **any save**.

## If you play it

**How his shop works matters here:** Weng Choi gives you one book per visit and then cycles. So the
Journal is the eleventh thing he offers, not something that shows up straight away. Expect to go back
and forth a few times.

**The check that proves it:** keep collecting past the tenth book and see the Journal turn up.

**The one I'd most want checked:** collect his books on a fresh character and make sure **all ten of
the originals still appear**. This release inserted into the middle of the list that hands them out,
and that's exactly the sort of edit that can quietly drop an entry.

**And after talking to the inquisitor about it — check you still have the book.**
